why: rc18: coloured English names, quest list flicker and boxes, quest list titles

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc18 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

New: a name family switched to English keeps the colour you picked.
Fix: the zone headers of the quest list no longer flip between English, Persian and empty boxes (the shaped Persian was read back as unknown text; header buttons are now re-checked every frame).
Fix: quest titles in the quest list beside the map are found through the quest log itself; 'Ready for turn-in' / 'Complete' are Persian.
New: /wowfa why prints why a quest list line stays English (paste it to us).
Includes rc7 to rc17.
